status: Six exact schedules and two-stage selection frozen before new candidate development feedback

gates.scorer: Unchanged existing scorer, prompts, tokenizer, precision, decoding and strict Google instruction checks.

screen.data: Identical original blend-search development set; all previously exposed.

ranking.units: Accuracy fractions; gate lower bounds use the configured two-gate family correction. Parameter-weighted mean includes all stored tensors, including zero-alpha and nonlayer tensors, counted once.

screen.rule: Advance exactly the first two candidates under this ranking, even if fewer than two are eligible.

development_validation.data: Most recently opened former holdout, now development validation.

final_development_selection.data: Pool screen and development-validation per-case outcomes; recompute paired-bootstrap gates on the pooled data. Do not average stage-level bounds.

ranking.units: Accuracy fractions; gate lower bounds use the configured two-gate family correction. Parameter-weighted mean includes all stored tensors, including zero-alpha and nonlayer tensors, counted once.

final_development_selection.eligibility: Both pooled development gates must pass.
final_development_selection.fallback: If neither qualifies, select the first under ineligible_order and permanently mark diagnostic_only.
final_development_selection.freeze: Seal selected label, exact checkpoint hash and eligible/diagnostic_only status before any new holdout evaluation.
final_development_selection.no_rescue: No holdout-based edits, reselection, or promotion of a diagnostic fallback.

cache: Reuse exposed observations only for exact checkpoint/scorer/configuration/case identity; no new learning or cache reuse for fresh rows.

fresh_holdout.sampling_owner: Parent prepared protocol; availability verification pending. No proposer access to new examples or partial results.
fresh_holdout.requirement: Freeze exact achieved sources, counts, admission, sampling and deduplication before new candidate feedback. Exclude every prior exposed case/task/body and disclose official ARC split and instruction source-mixture changes.
fresh_holdout.secondary_reporting: Report source and difficulty strata descriptively; do not use them to rescue eligibility.
fresh_holdout.outcome: Evaluate one sealed candidate and all three controls once. A diagnostic fallback cannot be accepted or exported as a repair.

limitations: Two-stage screening may eliminate a candidate that would rank better on pooled development.
Pooled development and fresh holdout have differing source mixtures; neither is an IID enlargement of original IFEval.
Architecture-based schedules are hypotheses, not established localization of knowledge or instruction following.

native_contract.grouping: Group disjoint exact names by positive alpha; omit zero-alpha targets. All tensor mapping entries remain explicit.
native_contract.constraints: No replacement payloads, training, core/scorer edits, or overlapping operations.
